new_records.summary_cs: Oficiální profil Sil obrany Ukrajiny uvádí, že jednotky brigády budují a posilují obranná postavení, zřizují pontonové mosty, provádějí rozminování na souši i ve vodních plochách, chrání strategické objekty, budují ochranné konstrukce, opravují komunikace a zřizují anti-drone ochranu. Profil rovněž uvádí pozice pontonéra a sapéra rozminování.
new_records.summary_en: An official Defense Forces of Ukraine profile states that brigade elements reinforce defensive positions, emplace pontoon bridges, conduct demining on land and in water, protect strategic sites, build protective structures, repair roads, and establish counter-drone protection. The profile also lists pontoneer and demining-sapper roles.
new_records.commander_cs: Plukovník Vadym Palij; oficiální profil uvádí jmenování do funkce velitele brigády v roce 2024.
new_records.commander_en: Colonel Vadym Palii; the official profile states that he was appointed brigade commander in 2024.
new_records.what_it_does_not_prove_cs: Veřejný náborový/return profil neprokazuje úplnou organizační strukturu (TO&E), nadřízenost, konkrétní typy a počty techniky, provozuschopnost, přesné místo nasazení ani bojovou připravenost. Stránka neuvádí datum publikace.
new_records.what_it_does_not_prove_en: The public recruiting/return profile does not establish full TO&E, command subordination, specific equipment types or quantities, serviceability, exact operational location, or combat readiness. The page does not provide a publication date.

sources.title: 194 окрема понтонно-мостова бригада «Самар»
sources.url_validation_basis: Direct official page read; exact unit title, capability description, vacancies and commander section matched. The page provides no publication date.

evidence.what_it_supports_cs: Podporuje existenci a veřejně deklarovaný profil 194. samostatné pontonově-mostní brigády „Samar“ a tvrzení, že její jednotky provádějí pontonové přemostění, rozminování země a vodních ploch, fortifikační práce, opravy cest a anti-drone ochranu. Stránka rovněž uvádí plukovníka Vadyma Palije jako velitele a jmenování v roce 2024.
evidence.what_it_supports_en: Supports the existence and publicly stated profile of the 194th Separate Pontoon-Bridge Brigade “Samar” and the claim that its elements conduct pontoon bridging, land and water demining, fortification work, road repair, and counter-drone protection. The page also names Colonel Vadym Palii as commander and states his appointment in 2024.
evidence.what_it_does_not_prove_cs: Neprokazuje úplné TO&E, nadřízenost, přesné stavy techniky nebo personálu, provozuschopnost, současné operační rozmístění ani readiness. Náborově orientovaný profil nemá datum publikace.
evidence.what_it_does_not_prove_en: Does not establish full TO&E, command subordination, exact equipment or personnel holdings, serviceability, current operational deployment, or readiness. The recruiting-oriented profile is undated.

trend_watch.title_cs: Oficiální ukrajinské náborové/return portály zvyšují veřejnou dohledatelnost ženijních jednotek a rolí
trend_watch.title_en: Official Ukrainian recruiting/return portals increase public discoverability of engineer units and roles
trend_watch.note_cs: Adresář Sil obrany Ukrajiny v roce 2026 veřejně zpřístupňuje profily mnoha jednotek včetně 194. pontonově-mostní brigády a 1. šlaho-obnovovací brigády, s popisy úkolů, veliteli a volnými rolemi. Jde o zlepšení source visibility, nikoli důkaz úplného ORBAT, TO&E nebo readiness.
trend_watch.note_en: The 2026 Defense Forces directory publicly exposes profiles for numerous units including the 194th pontoon-bridge brigade and 1st road-restoration brigade, with role descriptions, commanders and vacancies. This improves source visibility; it is not proof of complete ORBAT, TO&E or readiness.

Czech current equipment holdings/serviceability remain weakly exposed in public structured sources
Telegram direct public-web access to configured priority handles remains uneven
Formal current subordination/TO&E for the 194th pontoon-bridge brigade was not directly established by the official recruiting/return profile

source_families.name: Ukraine Defense Forces army.gov.ua / SZCh Return Programme — official unit profile directory
source_families.discovered_via: Ukrainian local-language unit-specific engineer search -> 194 pontoon-bridge brigade profile -> directory root -> cross-validation against a second engineering-focused unit profile
source_families.value: Reusable official Defense Forces directory exposing current public unit identities, role/capability descriptions, commanders where published, and vacancy-role surfaces. It is useful for current-profile discovery and corroboration.
source_families.access_limitations: Recruiting/return-facing pages may be undated and do not by themselves establish complete ORBAT, TO&E, subordination, equipment quantities, readiness or serviceability. Item-level facts require exact deep-link validation.

duplicates_existing.name: army.gov.ua New Contracts 2026 role catalogue
duplicates_existing.reason: Useful additional role surface within the same official Defense Forces recruiting/unit-profile ecosystem; not a separate source family.

deferred_candidates.name: Additional individual official Ukrainian unit portals surfaced by unit-specific search
deferred_candidates.reason: Individual unit pages were not promoted as a new family because repeated engineer-specific reuse and stable cross-unit coverage were not established in B56.

telegram.note: After three consecutive zero-material SUCCESS runs, B56 changed discovery dimensions: local-language engineer/sapper/demining/UGV terminology, unit/source chaining, and direct site:t.me/s searches over a wider recent window. Public surfaces for @GeneralStaffZSU and @ministry_of_defense_ua were reachable; no safely attributable engineer/EOD/UGV material post fell inside the exact B56 window. Other handles are counted UNAVAILABLE, not NO_HIT.

visual_osint.note: Search surfaced official unit-page imagery but no date-location-original-asset chain suitable for a new ENG-VIS.
